water_bodies.name: Lake Ilsanjo
water_bodies.desc: A 26-acre man-made lake constructed in the 1950s, the scenic heart of Annadel popular for fishing (bluegill, black bass) and trail junctions.

water_bodies.name: Ledson Marsh
water_bodies.desc: A 30-acre high-elevation seasonal freshwater marsh established in the late 1800s. Critical breeding habitat for the California red-legged frog and western pond turtle.

landmarks.name: Bennett Mountain Summit
landmarks.desc: The highest peak in Trione-Annadel State Park, offering commanding 360-degree views across Sonoma Valley, Santa Rosa, and Taylor Mountain.

landmarks.name: Lake Ilsanjo
landmarks.desc: The centerpiece lake of Annadel, named by combining the names of its original landowners Ilse and Joe.

landmarks.name: Ledson Marsh
landmarks.desc: High mountain marshland surrounded by dense mixed evergreen forests.

landmarks.name: Warren Richardson Trailhead / Visitor Center
landmarks.desc: Main park entrance with parking kiosk, restrooms, and interpretive displays along Channel Drive.

landmarks.name: Cobblestone Trailhead
landmarks.desc: Popular trailhead staging area off Channel Drive providing direct access to the rocky Cobblestone climb.

landmarks.name: Lawndale Trailhead
landmarks.desc: Southeastern park staging area on Lawndale Road, ideal for climbs toward Ledson Marsh.

landmarks.name: Schultz Trailhead
landmarks.desc: Eastern portal off Schultz Road accessing Ridge and Schultz trails.

landmarks.name: Spring Lake / Violet Horner Connector
landmarks.desc: Pedestrian and equestrian bridge connection to adjacent Spring Lake Regional Park.
